get.summary: The Server's version, its library, the machine it runs on and the state of its Worker.
The viewport: its mesh, camera and size. Frames come over the /ws/viewport WebSocket.

put.summary: Shows a mesh file in the viewport.

get.summary: A node's preview as a PNG, by the hash an event carried. It never changes, so cache it for ever.
The Server's library: its settings, its size and whether a rescan is running.
One page of projects: by name, or by relevance when searching.

post.summary: Writes a new project's files. It reaches the listings once the index has caught up.

get.summary: One page of the tags on projects, by name, with how many projects carry each.
One page of shared assets with their usage counts: by name, or by relevance when searching.
One page of the tags on shared assets, by name, with how many assets carry each.
What saving a shared asset would touch: its dependent projects, and how many are pinned.

post.summary: Opens a graph file, or joins the session that has it open, and starts evaluating it.

get.summary: The whole document, its undo history and the newest previews.

delete.summary: Ends a session. Unsaved edits refuse this unless discard is set.

get.summary: Every node this graph can use, with ports and settings, for a palette.

post.summary: Applies a batch of edits, whole or not at all, as one undo step.
Takes back the newest batch, whichever client sent it.
Puts back the newest undone batch.
Writes the document to its file. A file changed on disk refuses this unless force is set.
Evaluates again, which also rewrites previews a deleted cache has lost.

get.summary: The events after a number. /ws/graphs/{id}?since= sends the same events as they happen.

projects.description: The projects that depend on the asset, directly or through other assets.

pinned.description: How many of Projects a pin holds back; the rest rebuild.

unreadableDocuments.description:
Project and asset documents the index could not read. They may depend on the asset too, so a value above zero
means the counts are a lower bound.

items.description: One page of the dependent projects.

offset.description: The offset the page starts at.

limit.description: The most items a page holds.

AssetImpact.description: What saving a shared asset would touch: "affects 412 projects, 3 pinned" (plan §5).

total.description: How many assets match, on all pages.

offset.description: The offset the page starts at.

limit.description: The most items a page holds.

path.description: The asset's file, relative to `shared/`, with forward slashes.

revision.description: The content hash of the asset's file, or null when the file is missing.

usageCount.description: How many projects reference the asset directly.

AssetSummary.description: One shared asset as the browser shows it.

GraphCommand.description: One edit. Commands in a batch run in order, and every command sees the ones before it.

label.description: What the undo history calls it, or null for a name from the commands.

merge.description:
True to fold this batch into the last one when both change the same things, so that a whole drag is one undo.
A client leaves it false on the first batch of a drag.

GraphCommandBatch.description: Some edits, applied whole or not at all, and undone as one step.

ref.description:
A negative number the client picks. Later commands in this batch may use it wherever they name a node, and the
reply says which identity it became.

GraphCommandGraphConnect.description: Wires an output to an input, replacing what was on that input.

GraphCommandGraphDisconnect.description: Takes the wire off an input.

GraphCommandGraphMoveNodes.description: Moves nodes. A move never evaluates anything.

GraphCommandGraphRemoveNodes.description: Removes nodes, and the wires that touch them.

GraphCommandGraphSetSetting.description: Sets a setting of the graph: `baseWidth`, `baseHeight` or `seed`.

GraphCommandGraphSetText.description: Sets a text setting on a node, such as a blend mode.

value.description: One number per lane of the port.

GraphCommandGraphSetValue.description: Sets the numbers on a node's input. This is what a slider sends.

GraphCreatedNode.description: Which identity a client's int? GraphAddNode.Ref became.

nodes.description: Nodes that are new or differ, whole.

settings.description: Graph settings that are new or differ.

GraphDelta.description: What changed in the document, the same for an edit, an undo and a redo.

node.description: The node it concerns, or null.

port.description: The port it concerns, or null.

GraphDiagnostic.description: Something a graph's compiler or its file's reader has to say.

GraphEdgeState.description: One wire, from an output to an input.

created.description: The nodes a batch created under a `ref`.

GraphEditResult.description: The reply to an edit, an undo, a redo or a save.

revision.description: The document revision it shows; during a drag this trails the newest.

compiled.description: True if the plan was compiled; false if the numbers were written into the last one.

ran.description: How many operations ran. The rest came from the result cache.

reused.description: How many operations already had a result.

milliseconds.description: How long the Worker took, previews included.

previews.description: The previews that differ from the last evaluation's. All of them are in the state.

error.description: Why it did not finish, or null. "No Vulkan" means the Worker has no GPU.

revision.description: The document's revision when it was sent.

history.description: The undo history when it was sent.

label.description: What the edit, undo or redo was called.

GraphEvent.description:
One numbered event of a session. Sequence numbers rise by one, so a client that sees a gap has missed something
and reads `/events` or the state. Every client gets every event, its own edits included.

events.description: The events after the number asked for, oldest first.

GraphEventPage.description: The events after a number, for a client that does not hold a WebSocket or has missed some.

canUndo.description: Whether there is an edit to undo.

canRedo.description: Whether there is an edit to redo.

dirty.description: Whether the document differs from the file.

id.description: The node's identity, which is never reused within a session.

values.description: The numbers set on its inputs, by port. An input left out takes the type's default.

texts.description: The text settings set on it, by name.

GraphNodeState.description: A node as a document holds it.

path.description: What a document stores, such as `Colour/Levels`.

title.description: The last segment of the path.

hasPreview.description: Whether the type declares that its picture is worth showing.

settings.description: Its text settings, set with GraphSetText.

GraphNodeType.description: A node a client can add, for a palette.

path.description: The graph file on the Server's machine, absolute or relative to the library.

GraphOpenRequest.description: Opens a texture graph for editing. Opening a file that is already open joins its session.

kind.description: What it carries: Image, Float, Float4 and so on.

default.description: The numbers an unset input takes.

GraphPortDefinition.description: One port of a node type.

port.description: Its output port, or the usage of an Output node.

hash.description: The SHA-256 of the PNG's bytes, in lower-case hex.

GraphPreview.description: Where a node's picture is: `GET /api/v1/previews/{hash}`. Pixels never cross JSON.

minimum.description: Its lower bound, or null for none.

maximum.description: Its upper bound, or null for none.

accepted.description: The values it may take; empty for any.

GraphSettingDefinition.description: A value a node type or a graph lets an author set.

revision.description: Counts changes to the document, undo included.

sequence.description: The last event's number: pass it as `since` to follow from exactly here.

edges.description: The wires, by the input they arrive at.

previews.description: The newest preview of each node.

repairs.description: What reading the file had to drop or fix.

oneOf.description: The last evaluation, or null before the first.

GraphState.description: The reply to `GET /api/v1/graphs/{id}`: the whole document as the Server holds it.

GraphSummary.description: An open graph, for a list.

HostInfo.description: The machine and runtime a process runs on.

path.description: The project's folder, relative to `projects/`, with forward slashes.

pinned.description: True when a pin holds the project back, so a change to the asset does not reach it.

ImpactedProject.description: A project that depends on a shared asset.

path.description: The library's folder on the Server's machine.

schemaVersion.description: The version of `library.yaml` as it stands on disk.

texelDensity.description: The texel density new projects start from, in texels per metre.

defaultShader.description: The shader new projects start from.

exportTargets.description: The export targets the library builds for.

assetCount.description: The shared assets in the index.

indexing.description: Whether a rescan is running; counts and pages may lag the files until it ends.

LibraryInfo.description: The reply to `GET /api/v1/library`: what opening a library reads, and nothing more.

name.description: The project's display name. The Server makes its folder from it.

folder.description: Folders below `projects/` to put it in, with forward slashes, such as `props`.

total.description: How many projects match, on all pages.

offset.description: The offset the page starts at.

limit.description: The most items a page holds.

path.description: The project's folder, relative to `projects/`, with forward slashes.

referenceCount.description: How many shared assets the project references directly.

ProjectSummary.description: One project as the browser shows it. The project itself loads on open.

apiVersion.description: The major version of the REST API; it is the `v1` in the URL.

library.description: The library this Server owns, or null when it was started without one.

host.description: The machine and runtime the Server runs on.

worker.description: The Worker process as the Server sees it.

count.description: How many projects or assets carry it.

TagCount.description: A tag, and how many items carry it.

total.description: How many tags there are, on all pages.

offset.description: The offset the page starts at.

limit.description: The most items a page holds.

TagPage.description: One page of tags, by name.

distance.description: From the model's centre, in bounding radii.

ViewportCameraState.description: The viewport's camera: an orbit around the model.

path.description: The file's path, on the Server's machine.

ViewportMeshRequest.description: Asks the viewport to show a mesh.

mesh.description: The mesh's path, or null when none is open.

width.description: The size clients asked for, in pixels.

height.description: The size clients asked for, in pixels.

renderScale.description: The share of that size frames are rendered at, which drops while a client cannot keep up.

frames.description: How many frames this Server has published.

error.description: Why the last command failed, or null.

ViewportState.description: The reply to `GET /api/v1/viewport`. The Server owns all of this; a Worker can die without losing it.

connected.description: Whether a Worker is connected and answering.

version.description: The Worker's release version, from its hello.

processId.description: The Worker's process id, from its hello.

uptimeSeconds.description: How long the Worker has run, from its last health reply.

workingSetBytes.description: The Worker's memory, from its last health reply.

WorkerStatus.description: The Worker as the Server sees it. All but `Connected` are null while there is none.
